description:
Functional specifications / files: owning tracked Jido Chat/Mattermost adapter repositories, then verified ZAQ dependency integration in PR5 compatibility gate. Reuse zaq-h2i.4 declaration contract; add only missing selected-configuration requirements and prepare/upload/send/edit capabilities required by PR5. Do not touch unrelated WebWidget/native BO tasks, ignored deps, or publish changes without authorization.
Evidence: ZAQ pins Jido Chat 1.2.1 and Mattermost 93025d5205e070eebbecf89e539d32bdf1fde3ff. The same Mattermost revision in PR4 deps exposes send_message/send_file/edit_message but lacks file_requirements/prepare_upload/upload_prepared used by reference 98cd98c8f4171f2baef3177dfdeb193c607d941f. Reference Jido f17679337a9975bee43b9540cb08ac5cfc12b86a is evidence, not an automatic target pin. Verify current sources and existing candidate APIs before changes; use owning repository instructions.
Tests before implementation: declarations from selected settings with no I/O; exact upload preparation bytes/limits, uploads yielding actual provider IDs, partial upload facts, attachment send/edit request and receipts, absent metadata controlled failure, no automatic retries or hidden compound send bypass. Preserve existing adapter consumers.
Branches: configured/unresolved/not-applicable limits, explicit attachment-edit support, partial rejection/timeouts, concurrent connection isolation.
Mocking: provider HTTP boundary only; actual adapter/SDK APIs.
Documentation: source/revision, contract and compatibility proof here and upstream module docs; coordinate declarations under parent rather than duplicate them. No third-party publication authorized.
Action reuse: extend existing adapter operations and declarations, not a new ZAQ Action/resolver. Adapter owns provider request mechanics; Channel runtime owns policy/order/grouping and callback cardinality. Block only PR5 compatibility/integration that needs this adapter. If existing compatible release satisfies the contract, record proof and avoid source changes.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text: PR5 execution coordination: zaq-h2i.3.1 is closed, so the declaration prerequisite is satisfied. Verified PR5 dependency remains pinned to Mattermost 93025d5205e070eebbecf89e539d32bdf1fde3ff; owning tracked sibling repository ../jido_chat_mattermost exists. Existing dependency edge correctly blocks zaq-9j8.5, which blocks chat integration zaq-6rc.5. No upstream edits, ignored-deps edits or publication performed. Environment gate zaq-9j8.1 remains active pending Finch reconciliation; adapter implementation/compatibility proof must precede chat integration.
